def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def comps3(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); res=[]

                    st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
                res.append((col,cells))
    return res

def normgrid(cells):
    rs=[c[0] for c in cells]; cs=[c[1] for c in cells]
    h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]

def transform2(g):
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sh=comps3(g,bgc)
    exact=Counter(normgrid(ce) for c,ce in sh); colors=Counter(c for c,ce in sh)
    recs=[c for c in colors if colors[c]==1 and exact[normgrid([ce for cc,ce in sh if cc==c][0])]==1]
    pairs=[[(c,ce) for c,ce in sh if normgrid(ce)==n] for n,cn in exact.items() if cn==2]
    def key(m):
        rcells=[ce for cc,ce in sh if cc==recs[0]][0]
        d=min(mindist(ce,rcells) for c,ce in m)
        return (-len(m[0][1]), d)
    best=sorted(pairs,key=key)[0]
    rcells=[ce for cc,ce in sh if cc==recs[0]][0]
    donor=max(best,key=lambda m: mindist(m[1],rcells))[1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,j in donor: out[i][j]=recs[0]
    return out

def is_corner(n):
    rs=[sum(r) for r in n]; cs=[sum(c) for c in zip(*n)]
    h=len(n); w=len(n[0])
    # L-shape: two full arms along one row and one col, thickness 1
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if n[i][j]]
    if len(cells)!=h+w-1: return False
    return all(n[i][j] for i,j in [(i,0) for i in range(h)]+[(0,j) for j in range(w)]) or \
           True  # check any orientation: full row + full col intersecting
def corner_info(n):
    h,w=len(n),len(n[0])
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if all(n[i])]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if all(n[i][j] for i in range(h))]
    if len(rows)==1 and len(cols)==1 and sum(map(sum,n))==h+w-1:
        return (rows[0],cols[0],h,w)
    return None
for c,ce in sh:
    n=normgrid(ce); ci=corner_info(n)
    if ci: print('corner shape color',c,'size',len(ce),'r,c,h,w',ci,'normrow0',n[0])

src='''from collections import Counter

def comps3(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                col=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen or not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w) or g[a][b]!=col: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); cells.append((a,b))
                    st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
                res.append((col,cells))
    return res

def normgrid(cells):
    rs=[c[0] for c in cells]; cs=[c[1] for c in cells]
    h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in cells: g[r-min(rs)][c-min(cs)]=1
    return tuple(tuple(r) for r in g)

def corner_info(n):
    h,w=len(n),len(n[0])
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if all(n[i])]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if all(n[i][j] for i in range(h))]
    if len(rows)==1 and len(cols)==1 and sum(map(sum,n))==h+w-1:
        return (rows[0],cols[0],h,w)
    return None

def transform(grid):
    bg=Counter([c for r in grid for c in r]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sh=comps3(grid,bg)
    corners=sorted([(len(cells),col,cells,corner_info(normgrid(cells))) for col,cells in sh if corner_info(normgrid(cells))])
    size,rcol,rcells,(rr,cc,h,w)=corners[-1]
    rs=[r for r,c in rcells]; cs=[c for r,c in rcells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    groups={}
    for col,cells in sh:
        groups.setdefault(normgrid(cells),[]).append((col,cells))
    for norm,members in groups.items():
        if len(members)!=2: continue
        inside=[m for m in members if any(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1 for r,c in m[1])]
        outside=[m for m in members if m not in inside]
        if len(inside)==1 and len(outside)==1:
            ocol,ocells=outside[0]
            return [[rcol if (i,j) in ocells else grid[i][j] for j in range(len(grid[0]))] for i in range(len(grid))]
    return grid
'''

lib_src='''"""Reusable ARC helpers: connected components, normalized shape bitmaps, thin-L detection, and straddle-recolor solve."""

from collections import Counter


def color_components(grid, bg=None):
    """4-connected same-color components of a grid as (color, cells) pairs (bg = modal color if None)."""
    if bg is None:
        bg = Counter(c for r in grid for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0]); seen = set(); res = []
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] != bg and (i, j) not in seen:
                col = grid[i][j]; st = [(i, j)]; cells = []
                while st:
                    a, b = st.pop()
                    if (a, b) in seen or not (0 <= a < h and 0 <= b < w) or grid[a][b] != col:
                        continue
                    seen.add((a, b)); cells.append((a, b))
                    st += [(a + 1, b), (a - 1, b), (a, b + 1), (a, b - 1)]
                res.append((col, cells))
    return res


def norm_bitmap(cells):
    """Translation-normalized binary bitmap (tuple of tuple rows) of a cell set."""
    rs = [c[0] for c in cells]; cs = [c[1] for c in cells]
    h = max(rs) - min(rs) + 1; w = max(cs) - min(cs) + 1
    g = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r, c in cells:
        g[r - min(rs)][c - min(cs)] = 1
    return tuple(tuple(r) for r in g)


def thin_l_anchor(norm):
    """If a bitmap is a thin L (one full row + one full col, h+w-1 cells), return (row, col, h, w) of the full row/col, else None."""
    h, w = len(norm), len(norm[0])
    rows = [i for i in range(h) if all(norm[i])]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(norm[i][j] for i in range(h))]
    if len(rows) == 1 and len(cols) == 1 and sum(map(sum, norm)) == h + w - 1:
        return (rows[0], cols[0], h, w)
    return None


def bbox_of(cells):
    """Bounding box (r0, r1, c0, c1) of a cell list."""
    rs = [r for r, c in cells]; cs = [c for r, c in cells]
    return (min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs))


def straddle_recolor(grid):
    """Find the largest thin-L corner and recolor the outside member of the unique x2 twin pair whose other member lies inside the corner's bbox; return the new grid (or None if no such structure)."""
    comps = color_components(grid)
    corners = sorted((len(cells), col, cells, thin_l_anchor(norm_bitmap(cells)))
                     for col, cells in comps if thin_l_anchor(norm_bitmap(cells)))
    if not corners:
        return None
    _, rcol, rcells, _ = corners[-1]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = bbox_of(rcells)
    groups = {}
    for col, cells in comps:
        groups.setdefault(norm_bitmap(cells), []).append((col, cells))
    for members in groups.values():
        if len(members) != 2:
            continue
        inside = [m for m in members if any(r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1 for r, c in m[1])]
        outside = [m for m in members if m not in inside]
        if len(inside) == 1 and len(outside) == 1:
            _, ocells = outside[0]
            return [[rcol if (i, j) in ocells else grid[i][j] for j in range(len(grid[0]))] for i in range(len(grid))]
    return None
'''
